description: This file manages legacy authentication choices, including resolving deprecated choices, providing aliases, normalization, and error formatting for auth choices in a CLI context.

methods.name: resolveLegacyCliBackendChoice
methods.description: Resolves a legacy CLI backend choice if it ends with '-cli' by calling a deprecated provider auth choice resolver.

methods.name: resolveReplacementLabel
methods.description: Returns a trimmed label or a default string if input is empty.

methods.name: resolveLegacyAuthChoiceAliasesForCli
methods.description: Returns a sorted array of deprecated CLI auth choice IDs from provider auth choices.

methods.name: normalizeLegacyOnboardAuthChoice
methods.description: Normalizes an auth choice, replacing 'oauth' with 'setup-token' and resolving deprecated choices.

methods.name: isDeprecatedAuthChoice
methods.description: Checks if an auth choice is deprecated by attempting to resolve it as a legacy CLI backend choice.

methods.name: resolveDeprecatedAuthChoiceReplacement
methods.description: Provides a normalized replacement for a deprecated auth choice with a message.

methods.name: formatDeprecatedNonInteractiveAuthChoiceError
methods.description: Formats an error message for deprecated auth choices, suggesting the use of a new auth choice.
